name: Naji Kanounji
title: Software Engineer
tagline: I keep finding the slowest, most manual part of a process — and figuring out how to make it disappear.
summary:
I build backend systems and AI-powered products that replace manual work with something faster. At TomTom, I built an AI-powered Slack bot that triaged feedback for 2,000+ users and cut manual work by 80%, then owned the Developer Experience Demo system that ran live at CES 2025, getting promoted twice along the way. 
 Right now I'm going deeper into AI agents and RAG, applying both hands-on into MatchBeforeApply, an open-source platform that scores CV-to-job fit before you apply.
